user.title: HVAC Balancing
user.description: Choose the safe virtual Test Bench or configure active production control.

test_bench.title: Test Bench
test_bench.description: Create the observation-only virtual Test Bench runtime.

production.title: Production Active Control
production.description: Choose the central thermostat and reference temperature sensor. Zones are added on the next screen.

production_zone.title: Add balancing zone
production_zone.description: Add a room or area to balance. You may add as many zones as your installation requires.

production_central_assist.title: Central assist
production_central_assist.description: Choose how HVAC Balancing should request additional central airflow. Disabled is safest when no compatible central assist control is available.

production_central_assist_fan.title: Central assist fan
production_central_assist_fan.description: Choose a fan entity that represents the central blower or circulation fan.

production_central_assist_climate.title: Climate fan mode
production_central_assist_climate.description: Enter the thermostat fan-mode values used to start and stop central circulation.
